test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 6 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Abrogate
solution:
The solution is **Repeal**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym of the given word "**Abrogate**(repeal or do away with (a law, right, or formal agreement))" is Repeal(revoke or annul (a law or act of parliament)).
 
• Therefore **option 4 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's discuss information about other options:
 
 
• **Endure - **Suffer (something painful or difficult) patiently.

 
 
• *For example : "He endured the pain for her."***​**
 
 
 
• **Reveal -** Make (previously unknown or secret information) known to others. 
 
 
• **​***For example : "Mike revealed his true identity."*
 
 
 
• **Extend - **Cause to cover a wider area; make larger.
 
 
• **​***For example : "The garden has been extended."*
